text:
Rae (People Ops): Quick note : we have several cross-region handbacks stuck because managers used ad-hoc Slack approvals instead of the extension form. Need a repeatable fix + audit trail. cc @Sofia
Tom (Eng Manager): Sorry : I verbally approved my reviewers extension during a 1:1 and forgot to file. Reviewer now can't submit (button disabled). What's the safe process?
Sofia (HR Compliance): We can do a remediation unlock but need manager attestation recorded. Please send a CSV with manager_email, reviewee_email, form_id, attested_reason, attested_ts, attested_via (slack/email/meeting). Example row: tom@redwood.ai,alex@redwood.ai,form_99221,medical appointment,2026-05-10T14:05:00Z,slack
Rae (People Ops): Operational flow: 1) manager sends CSV to people-ops@redwood.ai 2) People Ops runs scoped job that reopens specific forms, attaches immutable attestation, issues audit id ATT-#### 3) we tag records so analytics excludes them from on-time metrics
Tom (Eng Manager): Ok sending CSV now. Do we need witness or can I attest solo?
Sofia (HR Compliance): Single manager attestation is allowed but include method (e.g., meeting) and any supporting doc. Compliance will spot-check a sample.
Anil (Calibration Chair): Chairs ask that reopened items appear in the "appendix" of the calibration packet with the audit id and attestation text. Also can we add a "manual-attest" flag so chairs can opt-out of strict median calculations?
Rae (People Ops): Yes : job will add manual-attest flag and append to packet. We'll include promotion-impact boolean column.
deadline-bot: System: global enforcement ran at 2026-05-10T23:59:00Z; 18 handbacks closed. Manual remediation requires People Ops approval token.
Tom (Eng Manager): CSV sent. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Rae (People Ops): Running job now. Please tell reviewers NOT to re-upload attachments until we confirm.
Rae (People Ops): Job complete : 1 row applied. Audit id ATT-4509. Record tagged: manual-attest=true, reason="medical appointment". Appendix updated.
Tom (Eng Manager): Reviewer resubmitted successfully. Appreciate the fast help.
Sofia (HR Compliance): We'll sample ATT- IDs for compliance review. Please keep supporting docs in the case ticket.
Rae (People Ops): Will add a quick how-to in the review ops page: "If you approved an extension outside the form, submit the CSV with attestation ASAP". Also filing a small UX ticket to show an "attested extension" banner in the form UI to reduce repeats.
Anil (Calibration Chair): Thanks : that banner would be helpful. Chairs will treat ATT- tagged items as "exclude from strict median" unless noted otherwise.
Tom (Eng Manager): Closing loop : thanks all.
